title: Insertion and evaluation comparisons are canonical mates
statement: Let O be a commutative ring, t in O, c a compactification of a scheme morphism, S a StrictEtaleCompactSupport presentation, and B its StrictEtaleBrownConstruction [lem-pur-etale-system-brown-construction]. At each level n, the mate of the inverse open-extension evaluation comparison under the system and finite open adjunctions equals the specified inverse-image evaluation comparison. The mate of the inverse left-extension comparison under the two extension/evaluation adjunctions equals the inverse compact-support evaluation comparison. These are equations of natural transformations on the entire ordinary unbounded derived categories.

proof.text: Apply the normalized derived-mate comparison to the exact ordinary open-extension adjunctions. On every complex representative, the recorded transpose and evaluation equations identify the inverse mate of inverse-image evaluation with inverse open-extension evaluation. Cancel the evaluation factorization isomorphisms, then use localization extensionality.

theorem etaleBrownEvaluationMate (n : ℕ) :
    (mateEquiv S.derivedOpenAdjunction (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction n)
      (.mk _ _ _ _ (S.openDerivedEvaluation n).inv)).natTrans =
        (S.openDerived.inverseEvaluation n).hom ∧
    (mateEquiv (S.PX.derivedAdj n) (S.PY.derivedAdj n)
      (.mk _ _ _ _ (B.leftExtension n).inv)).natTrans = (S.evaluation n).inv
